XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure to start engine and engage gears
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: BRAKES | P0504 | C1215 | B1024 | SWITCH | STOP | ON | ON | MIL | YELLOW | YELLOW |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Brakes

  • Device: Stop switch

  • Fault: Engine fault warning light illuminated, with vehicle functioning correctly

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • P0504 (Brake switch 1-2 relationship - Incorrect ratio)
  • C1215 (Fault - Brake pedal switch)
  • B1024 (Brake switch - Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty stop switch

• Action: Check that the stop switch is working correctly and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The faulty component showed no visible defects and, following its replacement, it was necessary to reset the control unit using diagnostic equipment, thereby permanently resolving the fault.
    The switch is located in the passenger compartment above the brake pedal.
